description: Score how well the authenticated user fits a company. Pro tier. Returns fitScore (0-100), 5-dimension breakdown (tech stack 40%, roles 25%, seniority 15%, location 10%, hiring trend 10%), matching skills, skill gaps, role alignment, and a hiring-momentum signal. Use for 'is Anthropic a good fit for me?' or 'compare these companies for me'. Not for scoring a specific job posting — use `match_job` for that.
name: company_fit

citation_url.description: hirejack.com URL to cite when surfacing this result

data.description: Company fit score for the authenticated user

breakdown.description: Per-dimension scores, each 0-100 (weights: tech 40%, roles 25%, seniority 15%, location 10%, trend 10%)

message.description: Present (with fitScore 0) when the user's profile has no skills yet

remoteFit.description: True when the company has remote postings

family.description: Role family the company hires for

match.description: True when the family covers one of the user's desired roles

pct.description: Share of company postings in this family, 0-100

seniorityFit.description: Null when the company has no postings at the user's seniority level

pct.description: Share of company postings at the user's level, 0-100

techMatchPct.description: Share of the company's top skills the user has, 0-100

techStackGaps.description: Company top skills the user lacks (capped at 10)

companyPct.description: Share of the company's postings mentioning it, 0-100

techStackMatch.description: Company top skills the user has

companyPct.description: Share of the company's postings mentioning it, 0-100

meta.description: Request/response metadata (pagination cursors, snapshot timestamps, applied filters)
